verdict.rationale: Viam's own docs explicitly list Python, Go, C++, TypeScript (and Flutter) SDKs for control logic, client apps, and lower-level access, and the GitHub repo confirms 'multiple SDKs are available for writing client applications that interface with the Viam RDK.' Docs also state that once a component/module exists, 'the SDKs work automatically,' implying broad API-surface coverage across languages. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation the SDKs are strongly-typed (generated from protobuf) rather than dynamically typed, and independent/hands-on verification that all four SDKs have full parity across the entire platform surface (C++ is described only as 'lower-level control,' suggesting narrower scope).
